segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Kathryn and it's the holiday season.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，现在正值节日季。

segments.en: Today we have a lesson all about a special December holiday.
segments.zh: 今天我们来讲一课，主题是十二月的一个特别节日。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: We are getting close to Christmas and of course today we are going to talk about Christmas in the United States and some of the typical traditions that you see over there.
segments.zh: 我们快到圣诞节了，当然今天我们要谈谈美国的圣诞节以及你在那里看到的一些典型传统。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we're going to be looking at a family as they wait for Christmas morning to arrive.
segments.zh: 所以我们要看着一个家庭，因为他们等待圣诞节的早晨到来。

segments.en: If you don't know what that is, don't worry, you'll hear us talk about it in a moment.
segments.zh: 如果您不知道那是什么，请不要担心，您一会儿会听到我们谈论它。

segments.en: But first let's listen to our dialogue.
segments.zh: 但首先让我们听听我们的对话。

segments.en: What are you doing awake?
segments.zh: 你怎么还没睡？

segments.en: I can't sleep.
segments.zh: 我睡不着。

segments.en: But it's almost midnight.
segments.zh: 可快到半夜十二点了。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: I'm too excited for Christmas morning.
segments.zh: 我太盼着圣诞节早上了，兴奋得睡不着。

segments.en: Also, I thought I heard Santa.
segments.zh: 而且我好像听到圣诞老人来了。

segments.en: Really?
segments.zh: 真的吗？

segments.en: How do you know it was Santa?
segments.zh: 你怎么知道那是圣诞老人？

segments.en: Well, I heard that naughty boys and girls get coal in their stockings so I thought I'd be nice and make Santa cookies.
segments.zh: 我听说淘气的小孩会在圣诞袜里收到煤块，所以我想表现乖一点，给圣诞老人做些饼干。

segments.en: I even left out some milk.
segments.zh: 我还给他放了些牛奶。

segments.en: I heard someone in the kitchen eating the cookies so I came downstairs.
segments.zh: 我听到有人在厨房吃饼干，就下楼来看看。

segments.en: Hmm.
segments.zh: 嗯。

segments.en: Well, I know that Santa won't come down the chimney with you hiding behind the tree spying on him.
segments.zh: 你躲在树后偷看，圣诞老人是不会从烟囱下来的。

segments.en: Really?
segments.zh: 真的吗？

segments.en: Really.
segments.zh: 真的吗。

segments.en: Let's go back upstairs and get back to bed.
segments.zh: 我们上楼回床上睡吧。

segments.en: That way we can let Santa do his job.
segments.zh: 这样圣诞老人才能安心做他的事。

segments.en: Then when you wake up, it will be Christmas already.
segments.zh: 等你醒来，就是圣诞节了。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Hey, honey, is that you?
segments.zh: 亲爱的，是你吗？

segments.en: Don't eat all the cookies.
segments.zh: 别把饼干全吃光了！

segments.en: I want some too.
segments.zh: 我也想吃。

segments.en: Alright, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now let's take a look at some language on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们来看看语言要点的一些表达。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: Okay, I just said it but here's that phrase again.
segments.zh: 好吧，我刚才说过，不过我们再来看一下这个短语。

segments.en: Christmas morning.
segments.zh: 圣诞节早晨。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So Christmas morning is December 25th in the morning, right?
segments.zh: 所以圣诞节早上是 12 月 25 日早上，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Okay, so the tradition is that small children will wake up early and run downstairs and they will find Christmas presents under the Christmas tree.
segments.zh: 好的，所以传统是小孩会早起并跑下楼，他们会在圣诞树下找到圣诞礼物。

segments.en: And so this is the Christmas morning tradition.
segments.zh: 这就是圣诞节的早晨传统。

segments.en: Many countries, they celebrate Christmas on Christmas Eve, the 24th, right?
segments.zh: 许多国家，他们在 24 日圣诞节前夕庆祝圣诞节，对吧？

segments.en: Alright, so Christmas Eve is December 24th, Christmas Day or if it's in the morning, Christmas morning is December 25th.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以平安夜是 12 月 24 日，圣诞节，或者说如果是早上的话，圣诞节早晨是 12 月 25 日。

segments.en: And as you said, kids come downstairs or go to where the Christmas tree is to look for their presents that Santa came and left for them.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，孩子们下楼或去圣诞树所在的地方寻找圣诞老人来给他们的礼物。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So the idea, the story is that Santa comes at night, late at night and brings presents for the children.
segments.zh: 所以这个想法，故事是圣诞老人晚上来，深夜，为孩子们带来礼物。

segments.en: And when the children wake up, they see the presents but Santa has already gone.
segments.zh: 当孩子们醒来时，他们看到了礼物，但圣诞老人已经走了。

segments.en: So Santa is a man, he's kind of a mythical figure with a big white beard and a red outfit and a red hat.
segments.zh: 所以圣诞老人是一个男人，他是一个神话般的人物，留着大白胡子、一套红色的衣服和一顶红色的帽子。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So his name is Santa Claus or just Santa.
segments.zh: 所以他的名字是圣诞老人或只是圣诞老人。

segments.en: There are many, many different names for Santa in different cultures and different countries.
segments.zh: 在不同的文化和不同的国家，圣诞老人有很多很多不同的名字。

segments.en: Yeah, some people like to call him Saint Nick or Saint Nicholas but most people will call him Santa in America.
segments.zh: 是的，有些人喜欢称他为圣尼克或圣尼古拉斯，但大多数人会称他为美国的圣诞老人。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So this is what happens or part of what happens during Christmas Eve and Christmas Day.
segments.zh: 所以这就是在平安夜和圣诞节期间发生的事情或部分发生的事情。

segments.en: And usually also, boys and girls will find our stockings that will be filled with candy or small toys as well.
segments.zh: 通常，男孩和女孩也会找到我们的长袜，里面装满了糖果或小玩具。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Stockings are basically socks.
segments.zh: 圣诞袜基本上就是袜子。

segments.en: But these are special socks that you don't wear, you hang them and a lot of people like to put them on the fireplace.
segments.zh: 但这些是你不穿的特殊袜子，你把它们挂起来，很多人都喜欢把它们放在壁炉上。

segments.en: They hang them from the fireplace.
segments.zh: 他们把它们挂在壁炉上。

segments.en: And like you said, Marco, they're filled with sweets.
segments.zh: 就像你说的，马可，它们里面装满了糖果。

segments.en: The story says that boys and girls who are nice get good things like sweets and toys and boys and girls who are naughty get coal.
segments.zh: 故事说，乖的男孩和女孩会得到糖果和玩具这样的好东西，而淘气的男孩和女孩会得到煤。

segments.en: Coal.
segments.zh: 煤炭。

segments.en: So that's that black material that we use to make a barbecue for example.
segments.zh: 这就是我们用来制作烧烤的黑色材料。

segments.en: Yeah, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: It's very dirty and it's not something you want in your stocking.
segments.zh: 它很脏，不会是你想放进圣诞袜里的东西。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So that's what we get in our stockings.
segments.zh: 这就是我们在圣诞袜里得到的东西。

segments.en: And now when the small boy and his father were talking, they were saying that he should go back to bed and not hide behind the tree.
segments.zh: 而现在，当那个小男孩和他的父亲在说话时，他们说他应该回到床上，不要躲在树后面。

segments.en: So if they're in the living room or they're downstairs in the house, what tree do they have?
segments.zh: 那么，如果他们在客厅里，或者他们在楼下的房子里，他们有什么树？

segments.en: We're not talking about a big real tree outside.
segments.zh: 我们不是在谈论外面的一棵大真正的树。

segments.en: We're talking about the Christmas tree.
segments.zh: 我们在谈论圣诞树。

segments.en: But you know, it's a long phrase, the Christmas tree.
segments.zh: 但你知道，这个短语有点长，圣诞树。

segments.en: We don't have to say it that way.
segments.zh: 我们不必这么说。

segments.en: When we have a Christmas tree inside the house, we can just call it the tree.
segments.zh: 当我们家里有一棵圣诞树时，我们可以称它为树。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And the Christmas tree, as many of you may have seen already, is a pine tree usually and you put decorations on it and the presents go under it.
segments.zh: 正如你们中的许多人可能已经看到的那样，圣诞树通常是一棵松树，你把装饰品放在上面，礼物就在它下面。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So you might hear this phrase, there are presents under the tree or there are many nice presents under the tree.
segments.zh: 所以你可能会听到这句话，树下有礼物，或者树下有很多漂亮的礼物。

segments.en: That means there are lots of nice presents under the Christmas tree.
segments.zh: 这意味着圣诞树下有很多漂亮的礼物。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And well, the kid wanted to stay behind the tree and spy on Santa Claus.
segments.zh: 好吧，这孩子想留在树后面监视圣诞老人。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So this is a verb, to spy.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个动词，spy（偷看）。

segments.en: This means to watch someone but to watch them while they don't know that you're watching them.
segments.zh: 意思是盯着某人看，而且是在对方不知道你在看的情况下。

segments.en: So you're hiding but looking at someone else.
segments.zh: 所以你在躲，但看着别人。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: You're spying.
segments.zh: 你是在偷看。

segments.en: This is where the noun comes, a spy like James Bond.
segments.zh: 这就是名词的来源，像詹姆斯邦德这样的间谍。

segments.en: James Bond spies.
segments.zh: 詹姆斯·邦德搞间谍活动。

segments.en: He is a very famous spy.
segments.zh: 他是一个非常有名的间谍。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: But in this case, the boy does not want Santa Claus to see him so he is spying on Santa Claus.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，男孩不希望圣诞老人见他，所以他在监视圣诞老人。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good stuff.
segments.zh: 非常好的东西。

segments.en: So, Marco, there's another great phrase in here that we often use just around Christmas.
segments.zh: 所以，Marco，这里还有一个很棒的短语，我们经常在圣诞节前后使用。

segments.en: What is it that Santa Claus does?
segments.zh: 圣诞老人是做什么的？

segments.en: Well, the way Santa Claus leaves presents for boys and girls is that he will come down the chimney.
segments.zh: 好吧，圣诞老人为男孩和女孩留下礼物的方式是他会从烟囱下来。

segments.en: We saw that when the dad said, well, Santa Claus won't come down the chimney if you're here hiding behind the tree.
segments.zh: 我们看到，当爸爸说，好吧，如果你躲在树后面，圣诞老人不会从烟囱下来。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So the chimney is part of the fireplace.
segments.zh: 所以烟囱是壁炉的一部分。

segments.en: A fireplace is where you have a fire in your house to keep warm.
segments.zh: 壁炉是你在家里生火取暖的地方。

segments.en: And the chimney is where the smoke goes to come outside.
segments.zh: 烟囱就是烟雾排到外面的地方。

segments.en: But Santa Claus goes the other way.
segments.zh: 但圣诞老人却走另一条路。

segments.en: He comes down the chimney from the roof into your house.
segments.zh: 他从屋顶顺着烟囱下来，进入你家。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And then he leaves the presents.
segments.zh: 然后他留下了礼物。

segments.en: So the father said, all right, so, you know, stop spying on Santa.
segments.zh: 所以父亲说，好吧，所以，你知道的，别再监视圣诞老人了。

segments.en: Let's go back upstairs and get back to bed.
segments.zh: 我们上楼回床上睡吧。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Get back to bed.
segments.zh: 回到床上。

segments.en: And this is a phrase that you're going to hear parents say a lot to their children.
segments.zh: 这是你会经常听到父母对孩子说的一个短语。

segments.en: So if the children are awake or walking around, you say, get back to bed.
segments.zh: 所以如果孩子们醒着或四处走动，你说，回到床上。

segments.en: That means go back to sleep.
segments.zh: 这意味着回去睡觉。

segments.en: Go back to sleep.

segments.en: That's right.

segments.en: And we want the kid to go back to sleep so we can let Santa do his job.

segments.en: All right.

segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So these Christmas traditions are, as we said, they're typically American, but many other cultures share similar traditions like this.
segments.zh: 因此，正如我们所说，这些圣诞节传统是典型的美国传统，但许多其他文化也有类似的传统。

segments.en: That's correct.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Obviously, traditions are different in every family.
segments.zh: 显然，每个家庭的传统都是不同的。

segments.en: Not everyone celebrates Christmas morning.
segments.zh: 不是每个人都庆祝圣诞节的早晨。

segments.en: Some people celebrate Christmas Eve.
segments.zh: 有些人庆祝平安夜。

segments.en: But most people will be familiar with Christmas stockings, Christmas trees, and Santa who comes down the chimney.
segments.zh: 但大多数人会熟悉从烟囱下来的圣诞袜、圣诞树和圣诞老人。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it also depends, I guess, on the culture and religion.
segments.zh: 所以这也取决于，我猜，文化和宗教。

segments.en: Some religions celebrate Christmas differently or not at all.
segments.zh: 有些宗教以不同的方式庆祝圣诞节，有些则根本不过。

segments.en: So it's actually a very interesting time of the year.
segments.zh: 所以这实际上是一年中非常有趣的时候。

segments.en: But if you look or if you can see any American movies, like I remember this one called The Santa Claus, you can see the typical American Christmas, snow and trees and presents and Santa Claus, a lot of things.
segments.zh: 但如果你看或者如果你能看到任何美国电影，比如我记得这部叫做圣诞老人的电影，你可以看到典型的美国圣诞节、雪和树木、礼物和圣诞老人，很多东西。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So a good way to end this would be to say have a very Merry Christmas.
segments.zh: 所以结束这一课的好方式就是祝大家圣诞快乐。

segments.en: That means have a nice holiday.
segments.zh: 这意味着有一个愉快的假期。

segments.en: Enjoy Christmas.
segments.zh: 享受圣诞节。

segments.en: If you're not going to celebrate Christmas for whatever reason, you can just say happy holidays.
segments.zh: 如果你不打算以任何原因庆祝圣诞节，你可以说节日快乐。

segments.en: Happy holidays.
segments.zh: 节日快乐。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And of course, you can go to our website, EnglishPod.com, where we want to know if you celebrate Christmas or what are the Christmas traditions in your country.
segments.zh: 当然，您可以访问我们的网站 Englishpod.com，我们想知道您是否庆祝圣诞节或您所在国家/地区的圣诞节传统是什么。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: We're very curious to hear those.
segments.zh: 我们很想听到这些。

segments.en: So we'll see you soon on EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 所以我们很快就会在 Englishpod.com 上见到你。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see you guys.
segments.zh: 我们会见到你们的。
